note.description: text written by a person or an agent

file.description: a file, by content (bytes kept in the blob store)

image.description: a picture or screenshot (bytes in the blob store; body: a caption or OCR)

audio.description: a recording (bytes in the blob store; body: a transcript)

video.description: a video (bytes in the blob store; body: a summary)

chat.description: a conversation or an excerpt of one

skill.description: a skill (SKILL.md text, helpers as linked file pods)

report.description: a result an agent produced (a journal entry, research, a review)

secret.token.description: an API key or token; agents handle it, never read it
